data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti, and Elisabeth Rizzotti. The target operates within a sector of 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy. Newcleo has raised $755M+ to date.

The analysis applied stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given available data. Using the $755M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable; while 6 nuclear energy peers exist in the broader market, insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (fewer than 3 datapoints meeting narrow filters) precluded reliable median benchmarking without risking misleading distortion.

The single methodological input supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median point of $1.4B. Key uncertainties include the absence of a sufficiently dense peer set at identical stage and valuation tier, which constrains cross-validation. The stage-progression anchor relies on the assumption that $755M in cumulative capital tracks reasonably to post-money valuation; departure from this assumption would shift results materially. Refinement would benefit from additional late-stage private nuclear comps or more granular public market multiples applicable to the company's specific technology posture.
